stem: Which sentence best explains why members of a book club are likely to read a whole book?

options.label: A
options.text: Reading helps you learn to say new words. (paragraph 2)

options.label: B
options.text: The desire to be prepared will encourage you to finish reading what you started. (paragraph 3)

options.label: C
options.text: You might already know some members in your book club. (paragraph 6)

options.label: D
